title: EXCLUSIVE: Wife says Filipinos in Russia lured by P180K pay, P400K bonus as 'cleaners' before military training
summary: Several Filipinos were lured to Russia under false pretenses before being placed in military training, the wife of one of the workers told ABS-CBN News.
